parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: The filter condition. If you do not specify this parameter, all instances are queried.

parameters.name: pageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number.

Valid values: 1 to 100,000,000.

If you specify a value less than 1, the system uses 1. If you specify a value greater than 100,000,000, the system uses 100,000,000.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries to return on each page.

Valid values: 10 to 200.

If you specify a value less than 10, the system uses 10. If you specify a value greater than 200, the system uses 200.

parameters.name: resourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs.

parameters.name: seriesCodes
parameters.description:
The primary series codes of the instances.

Valid values:

- standard: Standard Edition

- ultimate: Platinum Edition

- professional: Professional Edition

- dedicated: Exclusive Edition

- shared: Shared Edition

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: A list of resource tags used to filter instances.
